notes.title: 'MOAI 2: Path to Another World' is available for MAC users!
notes.content:
Greetings, Friends!

We a happy to announce that MAC-versions of a fabulous 'MOAI 2’ is out now!*
Grab your МАС devices and go to exciting adventure to Another World!
https://pp.vk.me/c622027/v622027644/3a540/E0BOvgT2ZP0.jpg
* available languages: English, German and Russian
